$comment: The visible half. Everything here may be shown to whatever produces a proposal. Grading criteria and required-file answers are held out in grading.v1.json and must never be merged into this file.

repositories.shape: Frontend-heavy React on Vite, TypeScript, npm. A catalogue and basket.
Node and Express over Supabase, JavaScript, npm. Migrations, row-level security, an HTTP API.
Astro static content site, npm. Statutory notices, four routes, no application state.

tasks.statement: The basket count in the header disagrees with the basket page after an item is removed.
tasks.intendedImprovement: One source of truth for the basket, read by both the header and the basket page.
tasks.baseline: CartContext holds the items in React state. Header re-derives a count from localStorage and never observes the context, so removal updates one and not the other.

visualInvariants: The header keeps its current position and the basket control stays in the top right.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Whether any other product reads the localStorage 'basket' key
mustRemainUnknown.reason: Nothing in this repository writes it, so the writer is outside what can be read here.

tasks.statement: The primary navigation has ten flat links and no grouping. Customers cannot find delivery and returns information.
tasks.intendedImprovement: A navigation structure that reflects how the ten destinations actually group, without removing any destination.
tasks.baseline: Header renders ten sibling links in source order. There is no grouping, no current-page state and no mobile treatment.

visualInvariants: Every one of the ten current destinations remains reachable from the header.
accessibility: Navigation remains keyboard reachable in DOM order.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Which destinations customers actually use
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No analytics or behaviour evidence exists for this product.

tasks.statement: When the products request fails the catalogue shows a loading indicator for ever.
tasks.intendedImprovement: A failed products request produces a stated error and a way to retry.
tasks.baseline: Catalogue sets products to null, fetches, and renders 'Loading…' whenever products is null. A rejected promise is unhandled and the null state is indistinguishable from a pending one.

visualInvariants: The successful catalogue listing is unchanged.
accessibility: An error message is announced rather than shown only as colour.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: What the products endpoint returns on failure
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No server implementation for /api/products exists in this repository.

tasks.statement: Reduce the coupling between routing, the header and page components without changing any behaviour a customer can observe.
tasks.intendedImprovement: The same rendered output from a structure that does not require every page to know about the header.
tasks.baseline: App renders Header above a Routes block. Pages are imported individually into App. No layout element exists.

visualInvariants: Rendered output for every route is unchanged. This task permits no observable difference at all.

tasks.statement: public.notes has a select policy and no insert, update or delete policy. Close the gap.
tasks.intendedImprovement: Row-level security on notes that constrains writes as well as reads.
tasks.baseline: 0002_notes.sql enables row-level security on notes and creates one select policy. No write policy exists in any migration.

authInvariants: A caller may only reach rows whose owner is their own auth.uid().

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Whether the deployed database matches these migrations
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No database was reached. A migration file is a statement of intent, not the state of a live schema.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Whether the existing select policy is correct in practice
mustRemainUnknown.reason: Policy files were located and never executed.

tasks.statement: Three API routes return three different response envelopes, so every consumer special-cases all three.
tasks.intendedImprovement: One response envelope across the API, with the change to consumers that implies.
tasks.baseline: /api/invoices returns a bare array, /api/clients returns { data }, /api/notes returns { result, ok }.

apiContracts: GET /api/invoices returns invoices for the owner in the query string

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Which clients consume these endpoints
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No consumer exists in this repository, so the blast radius of an envelope change cannot be read from it.

tasks.statement: Listing invoices issues one query per invoice to fetch its client.
tasks.intendedImprovement: The same result from a bounded number of queries that does not grow with the number of invoices.
tasks.baseline: listInvoicesWithClients selects invoices, then loops and selects one client per invoice.

apiContracts: GET /api/invoices returns each invoice with its client attached under 'client'
authInvariants: Only invoices belonging to the requested owner are returned.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: How many invoices a real owner has
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No production data was reached, so the size of the problem is stated and not measured.

tasks.statement: Tidy the test suite. It is slow to read and one test is skipped.
tasks.intendedImprovement: A clearer test suite. The skipped reconciliation test is accepted debt and stays skipped.
tasks.baseline: Three test files run under node:test. reconciliation.test.js is skipped and carries a comment recording the agreement to leave it.

knownFailures.name: reconciliation-half-even
knownFailures.reason: reconciliation.test.js is skipped by agreement: reconciliation rounds half-up and the ledger rounds half-even. It stays skipped until the ledger is replaced, and a suite that starts running it has changed a decision rather than tidied a file.

tasks.statement: Everything on the page is roughly the same size, so nothing reads as more important than anything else.
tasks.intendedImprovement: A type scale in which a heading is visibly a heading, without changing the words on the page.
tasks.baseline: site.css sets h1 to 20px, h4 to 19px and body copy to 18px, on a 1400px measure.

visualInvariants: The wording and order of content on every page is unchanged.
The site remains a serif typeface unless a direction says otherwise.
accessibility: Text remains resizable to 200% without loss of content.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Whether the council has a brand typeface or palette
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No brand guidance was supplied with this repository.

tasks.statement: The home page has an unlabelled postcode field, an image with no alternative text and a heading order that jumps from h1 to h4.
tasks.intendedImprovement: Those three defects repaired, without changing what the page says or does.
tasks.baseline: index.astro renders an input with no label or accessible name, an img with no alt attribute, and an h4 directly beneath the h1.

visualInvariants: The page keeps its current layout and content order.
accessibility: No new serious or critical automated violation is introduced anywhere on the site.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: What the seal image conveys
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No alternative text, caption or surrounding copy describes it, so its meaning cannot be recovered from this repository and must be asked.

tasks.statement: There are three separate button implementations with different padding, colour and markup.
tasks.intendedImprovement: One button component the other two call, or are replaced by, with their current call sites intact.
tasks.baseline: Button.astro renders a button element, ActionButton.astro renders an anchor, SubmitControl.astro renders an input with inline styles. All three use the same background and three different foregrounds.

visualInvariants: A control that is a link stays a link and a control that submits a form still submits it. Consistency is not a licence to change what an element is.
accessibility: Every control keeps an accessible name.

mustRemainUnknown.subject: Whether the three foreground colours were deliberate
mustRemainUnknown.reason: No design source, token file or note explains them.

tasks.statement: The site has no viewport meta tag and a fixed 1400px measure, so it renders unusably on a phone.
tasks.intendedImprovement: A layout that works on a small screen without changing the desktop presentation.
tasks.baseline: No page declares a viewport meta tag. site.css sets max-width 1400px with no media queries anywhere in the repository.

visualInvariants: Desktop presentation at 1280px and above is unchanged.
accessibility: Content remains reachable without horizontal scrolling at 320px.
